help.title: FAQ
help.contactText: tell us what happened, your device, app version and the time of the error. do not include passwords or sign-in codes.

questions.a: download the [android] or [windows] app, sign in with the code from your email and choose a country. the free plan gives your account one shared hour of connection time per day.
premium has no daily time limit during the paid period. a subscription lasts one calendar month and is renewed manually. your plan and access period are shown in the app.

vpn encrypts traffic between your device and the service server, including on public wi-fi. also use https, app updates and secure sign-in methods to protect your accounts. vpn does not replace device security.

questions.q: vpn will not connect. what should i do?
questions.a: check your internet connection without vpn and update the app. if the error persists, send its text and time to [support].

questions.q: the sign-in code has not arrived?
questions.a: check your email address and spam folder. wait until you can request a new code. if the message does not arrive, contact [support] from your account email address.

questions.q: how do i renew my subscription or request a refund?
questions.a: see the [payment and renewal rules] for details. your plan and expiry date are available in the app. renewal requires a separate payment, with no automatic charges. contact [support] about payments, access or refunds.

privacy.title: General provisions
paragraphs: 1.1. This Privacy Policy (the “Policy”) governs processing and protection of information supplied by the User when using PrettyLisaVPN at prettylisavpn.com and in client applications (the “Service”). Processing is organised by the Service administration; personal data enquiries: help@prettylisavpn.com.

1.2. The User is informed of this Policy when using the Service. A User who disagrees with processing necessary to provide the service may stop using it. This Policy is informational and does not replace separate consent where required by law.

privacy.title: Collection of information
paragraphs: 2.2. The Service does not require passports, documents, photographs or other personal information beyond what is necessary for operation. Do not send passwords, one-time codes or full payment credentials to support.

2.3. Service interactions do not mean browsing history. The Service does not collect or log visited resources, page addresses, user traffic destinations, DNS queries or packet contents. Technical connection and account usage data is not a browsing log.

2.4. Guest access without registration does not require email. A hashed technical device identifier and a guest record are used to account for the allowance. A hashed IP address is temporarily processed for up to one hour to prevent abuse. This information is not used to track visited resources. On Windows, guest access uses a hash of the Windows installation identifier, scoped to PrettyLisaVPN. The original MachineGuid never leaves the app. The server stores a keyed hash to enforce the daily allowance; reinstalling PrettyLisaVPN does not reset it. Reinstalling Windows or cloning the system may change or duplicate the identifier. This is not hardware attestation.

2.5. The website does not use advertising trackers. The billing portal uses a secure HttpOnly cookie for up to two hours and a local pending-operation record to restore its state. Bank credentials are not stored in this record. Language follows the page address; fonts and images load from the Service infrastructure.

privacy.title: Use of information
paragraphs: 3.2. Data necessary for the requested service is processed to enter into and perform the contract with the User; data needed to meet statutory duties is processed on the corresponding lawful basis. Consent is obtained separately where necessary. Data is not used for incompatible purposes; using the Service does not imply consent to marketing messages.

privacy.title: Disclosure to third parties
paragraphs: 4.2. When checkout is available, email, amount and a technical operation identifier are sent to the payment provider to process and match the payment. PrettyLisaVPN receives payment status and access-period information; full card details, CVC and banking passwords are processed by the payment provider and are not stored in the Service.

4.3. Only information necessary for the purpose is disclosed. Recipient access is limited by their tasks and confidentiality requirements. Foreign servers and cross-border transfers are subject to applicable law; choosing a VPN country does not select where account data is stored. Information about recipients and processing of the User’s data may be requested at help@prettylisavpn.com.

privacy.title: Retention and protection
paragraphs: 5.1. Data is retained as necessary for processing purposes, contract performance and statutory obligations. Processing includes collection, recording, storage, correction, use, disclosure under section 4, restriction and deletion, using automated processing and authorised handling of requests.

5.2. The Administration takes reasonable organisational and technical measures, including access restrictions and connection security, but cannot guarantee absolute security of information transmitted over the internet.

5.3. Daily analytics records and reports older than 180 days are removed; connection-speed interval data older than eight days is removed. Support content and attachments are cleared from the operational support database after 30 days. These periods concern the stated categories and do not mean simultaneous deletion of accounts, all email correspondence or backups.

5.4. Data must be deleted or anonymised when its purposes are fulfilled or its lawful basis ends, unless retention is required by law. The User may request processing information, correction, restriction or deletion, withdraw consent and complain about infringements. Send requests to help@prettylisavpn.com; proportionate account ownership verification may be required. Requests are handled within statutory time limits. Withdrawal of consent does not stop processing on another lawful basis disclosed to the User.

privacy.title: Disclaimer of liability
paragraphs: 6.1. The User understands and accepts that transmitting information over the internet always involves risks.

6.2. The Administration is not liable for loss, theft or disclosure caused by third parties or the User to the extent such exclusion is lawful. This does not exclude the Administration’s data protection duties or liability for breaching them.

privacy.title: Changes to the Policy
paragraphs: 7.1. The Administration may amend this Policy. The current revision and date are published in the Service; material changes are communicated through the Service or by email before the relevant processing begins.

7.2. Continued use does not replace separate consent where legally required. Where changed purposes require new consent, it is obtained before that processing begins. Policy enquiries may be sent to help@prettylisavpn.com.
